purpose: Draft behavioral evaluation fixtures for the 122 newly added Skills. Fixtures are prompts and rubrics, not evidence of runtime passes.
evaluation_method: Run each prompt against the named Skill in the intended runtime. Score each expected behavior and each must_not item, record model/runtime/date/output/rationale, and revise the Skill when failures reveal ambiguous instructions. Fixture structure validation does not execute or score a model.
